title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Conservative perfect-gas formulation and coefficient definitions are documented in report.tex and implemented in gas/flux/residual modules.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh.cpp reads unstructured CGNS zones, topology, BC families and computes geometry/adjacency.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Cell-centred face residual assembly and globally reduced norms are visible in residual.cpp/solver.cpp.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov flux and frozen face Jacobian are implemented and honestly described as diffusive.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip and no-slip adiabatic boundary paths and output semantics are implemented/documented.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Least-squares piecewise-linear reconstruction with production activation and fallback accounting is in reconstruction.cpp and report.tex.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth-Jespersen fallback and density/pressure admissibility scaling are implemented; delivered metadata records controls.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Viscous gradients, Newtonian/Fourier treatment and tangential force split are described and supported by source/output schema.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Matrix-free GMRES and frozen Rusanov LU-SGS are implemented; several steady packages report nonzero inner-target misses.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Source enforces transient dt/final-time/inner-control bounds; delivered Re200 metadata reports BDF2 controls, t=300 and zero inner-target misses. Re200 was not rerun.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS owned/ghost partition and neighbor schedules are implemented and np=8 packages exist; report qualifies the available np4/np8 comparison as not a pure rank-only experiment.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
